images.alt_en: Illustration inspired by the story: Ketterly Osa had called the Long Carry for forty-nine years from a chair bolted to the box floor, and for the last four she had needed an oxygen line to reach it.
images.alt_sl: Ilustracija po zgodbi: Ketterly Osa je devetinštirideset let sodila Dolgi prenos s stola, privitega v tla kabine, zadnja štiri leta pa je za pot do njega potrebovala cevko s kisikom.
